import json, re
try:
    raw = vars.get('state')

    st['runs'] = st.get('runs', 0) + 1
    route, say = 'talk_b', ''
    if st.get('hops_left', 0) > 0:
        st['hops_left'] -= 1
        if st['hops_left'] == 0:
            route = 'talk_a'
            say = 'Hopped. Hop count ' + str(vars.get('hop_count')) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs']) + '.'
        else:
            route = 'hop'
    else:
        said = str(vars.get('said') or '')
        m = re.search(r'\b(ping|again|hop|code|check|date|crash|bye)\b', said.lower())
        word = m.group(1) if m else str(vars.get('cmd') or 'other')
        st['turn'] = st.get('turn', 0) + 1
        tag = str(st['turn']) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs'])
        any_ = str(vars.get('code_any') if vars.get('code_any') is not None else '<unset>')
        last = str(vars.get('code_last') if vars.get('code_last') is not None else '<unset>')
        if word == 'ping':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Pong ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'again':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Again ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'hop':
            st['hops_left'] = 12
            vars['hop_count'] = '0'
            route = 'hop'
        elif word == 'code':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Code noted, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
            vars['code_any'] = ''
            vars['code_last'] = ''
        elif word == 'check':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Slots now, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'date':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Date slot ' + str(vars.get('when_date')) + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'crash':
            route = 'crasher'
        elif word == 'bye':
            vars['farewell'] = 'Custom farewell for ' + str(vars.get('first_name')) + ' after turn ' + tag + '.'
            route = 'end_custom'
        else:
            route, say = 'talk_b', 'Unknown command ' + said[:60] + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
    vars['route'] = route
    vars['say_next'] = say
    vars['brain_runs'] = str(st['runs'])
    vars['state'] = json.dumps(st)
except Exception as e:
    vars['route'] = 'error'
    vars['say_next'] = 'Brain error.'
    vars['brain_error'] = repr(e)[:200]

import json, re
try:
    raw = vars.get('state')
    st = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) and raw else dict()
    st['runs'] = st.get('runs', 0) + 1
    route, say = 'talk_b', ''
    if st.get('hops_left', 0) > 0:
        st['hops_left'] -= 1
        if st['hops_left'] == 0:
            route = 'talk_a'
            say = 'Hopped. Hop count ' + str(vars.get('hop_count')) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs']) + '.'
        else:
            route = 'hop'
    else:
        said = str(vars.get('said') or '')
        m = re.search(r'\b(ping|again|hop|code|check|date|crash|bye)\b', said.lower())
        word = m.group(1) if m else str(vars.get('cmd') or 'other')
        st['turn'] = st.get('turn', 0) + 1
        tag = str(st['turn']) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs'])
        any_ = str(vars.get('code_any') if vars.get('code_any') is not None else '<unset>')
        last = str(vars.get('code_last') if vars.get('code_last') is not None else '<unset>')
        if word == 'ping':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Pong ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'again':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Again ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'hop':
            st['hops_left'] = 12
            vars['hop_count'] = '0'
            route = 'hop'
        elif word == 'code':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Code noted, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
            vars['code_any'] = ''
            vars['code_last'] = ''
        elif word == 'check':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Slots now, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'date':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Date slot ' + str(vars.get('when_date')) + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'crash':
            route = 'crasher'
        elif word == 'bye':
            vars['farewell'] = 'Custom farewell for ' + str(vars.get('first_name')) + ' after turn ' + tag + '.'
            route = 'end_custom'
        else:
            route, say = 'talk_b', 'Unknown command ' + said[:60] + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
    vars['route'] = route
    vars['say_next'] = say
    vars['brain_runs'] = str(st['runs'])
    vars['state'] = json.dumps(st)
except Exception as e:
    vars['route'] = 'error'
    vars['say_next'] = 'Brain error.'
    vars['brain_error'] = repr(e)[:200]

import json, re

    raw = vars.get('state')

    st['runs'] = st.get('runs', 0) + 1
    route, say = 'talk_b', ''
    if st.get('hops_left', 0) > 0:
        st['hops_left'] -= 1
        if st['hops_left'] == 0:
            route = 'talk_a'
            say = 'Hopped. Hop count ' + str(vars.get('hop_count')) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs']) + '.'
        else:
            route = 'hop'
    else:
        said = str(vars.get('said') or '')
        m = re.search(r'\b(ping|again|hop|code|check|date|crash|bye)\b', said.lower())
        word = m.group(1) if m else str(vars.get('cmd') or 'other')
        st['turn'] = st.get('turn', 0) + 1
        tag = str(st['turn']) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs'])
        any_ = str(vars.get('code_any') if vars.get('code_any') is not None else '<unset>')
        last = str(vars.get('code_last') if vars.get('code_last') is not None else '<unset>')
        if word == 'ping':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Pong ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'again':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Again ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'hop':
            st['hops_left'] = 12
            vars['hop_count'] = '0'
            route = 'hop'
        elif word == 'code':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Code noted, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
            vars['code_any'] = ''
            vars['code_last'] = ''
        elif word == 'check':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Slots now, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'date':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Date slot ' + str(vars.get('when_date')) + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'crash':
            route = 'crasher'
        elif word == 'bye':
            vars['farewell'] = 'Custom farewell for ' + str(vars.get('first_name')) + ' after turn ' + tag + '.'
            route = 'end_custom'
        else:
            route, say = 'talk_b', 'Unknown command ' + said[:60] + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
    vars['route'] = route
    vars['say_next'] = say
    vars['brain_runs'] = str(st['runs'])
    vars['state'] = json.dumps(st)
except Exception as e:
    vars['route'] = 'error'
    vars['say_next'] = 'Brain error.'
    vars['brain_error'] = repr(e)[:200]

import json, re
try:
    raw = vars.get('state')
    st = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) and raw else dict()
    st['runs'] = st.get('runs', 0) + 1
    route, say = 'talk_b', ''

        st['hops_left'] -= 1
        if st['hops_left'] == 0:
            route = 'talk_a'
            say = 'Hopped. Hop count ' + str(vars.get('hop_count')) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs']) + '.'
        else:
            route = 'hop'
    else:
        said = str(vars.get('said') or '')
        m = re.search(r'\b(ping|again|hop|code|check|date|crash|bye)\b', said.lower())
        word = m.group(1) if m else str(vars.get('cmd') or 'other')
        st['turn'] = st.get('turn', 0) + 1
        tag = str(st['turn']) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs'])
        any_ = str(vars.get('code_any') if vars.get('code_any') is not None else '<unset>')
        last = str(vars.get('code_last') if vars.get('code_last') is not None else '<unset>')
        if word == 'ping':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Pong ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'again':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Again ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'hop':
            st['hops_left'] = 12
            vars['hop_count'] = '0'
            route = 'hop'
        elif word == 'code':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Code noted, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
            vars['code_any'] = ''
            vars['code_last'] = ''
        elif word == 'check':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Slots now, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'date':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Date slot ' + str(vars.get('when_date')) + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'crash':
            route = 'crasher'
        elif word == 'bye':
            vars['farewell'] = 'Custom farewell for ' + str(vars.get('first_name')) + ' after turn ' + tag + '.'
            route = 'end_custom'
        else:
            route, say = 'talk_b', 'Unknown command ' + said[:60] + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
    vars['route'] = route
    vars['say_next'] = say
    vars['brain_runs'] = str(st['runs'])
    vars['state'] = json.dumps(st)
except Exception as e:
    vars['route'] = 'error'
    vars['say_next'] = 'Brain error.'
    vars['brain_error'] = repr(e)[:200]

{"event":"function_call_start","function":"code_exec","args":{"timeout_ms":10000,"code":"
import json, re
try:
    raw = vars.get('state')
    st = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) and raw else dict()
    st['runs'] = st.get('runs', 0) + 1
    route, say = 'talk_b', ''
    if st.get('hops_left', 0) > 0:
        st['hops_left'] -= 1
        if st['hops_left'] == 0:
            route = 'talk_a'
            say = 'Hopped. Hop count ' + str(vars.get('hop_count')) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs']) + '.'
        else:
            route = 'hop'
    else:
        said = str(vars.get('said') or '')
        m = re.search(r'\b(ping|again|hop|code|check|date|crash|bye)\b', said.lower())
        word = m.group(1) if m else str(vars.get('cmd') or 'other')
        st['turn'] = st.get('turn', 0) + 1
        tag = str(st['turn']) + ', brain runs ' + str(st['runs'])
        any_ = str(vars.get('code_any') if vars.get('code_any') is not None else '<unset>')
        last = str(vars.get('code_last') if vars.get('code_last') is not None else '<unset>')
        if word == 'ping':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Pong ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'again':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Again ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'hop':
            st['hops_left'] = 12
            vars['hop_count'] = '0'
            route = 'hop'
        elif word == 'code':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Code noted, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
            vars['code_any'] = ''
            vars['code_last'] = ''
        elif word == 'check':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Slots now, any ' + any_ + ', last ' + last + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'date':
            route, say = 'talk_a', 'Date slot ' + str(vars.get('when_date')) + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
        elif word == 'crash':
            route = 'crasher'
        elif word == 'bye':
            vars['farewell'] = 'Custom farewell for ' + str(vars.get('first_name')) + ' after turn ' + tag + '.'
            route = 'end_custom'
        else:
            route, say = 'talk_b', 'Unknown command ' + said[:60] + ', turn ' + tag + '.'
    vars['route'] = route
    vars['say_next'] = say
    vars['brain_runs'] = str(st['runs'])
    vars['state'] = json.dumps(st)
except Exception as e:
    vars['route'] = 'error'
    vars['say_next'] = 'Brain error.'

    vars['route'] = route

    vars['brain_runs'] = str(st['runs'])
    vars['state'] = json.dumps(st)
except Exception as e:
